Resolve commit authority aliases by Issue identity (#147)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-24
  description: |-
    Parse `codeon.authority` as an IssueReference instead of a lowercase-only identifier. Prefix and workspace-key aliases authenticate the same Issue only when the shared resolver maps them to the same IssueId. New requirements, preparations, and messages use the preferred uppercase prefix; historical key metadata remains valid. Sealed preparation receipts, canonical bytes, and digests stay exact-string compared.
